$comment: #255 / #381 — known input-plugin metadata gaps (#381 added epaRegistrationNumber for herbicides, insecticides and fungicides). Every entry needs a reason. The coverage test fails on any gap not listed here AND on any entry that is no longer a gap, so remove entries as plugins are label-verified.

entries.reason: Generic plugin with no single product label; 2,4-D amine jugs differ by registrant, so no one label's formulation statement applies (checked 2026-09-25).
Generic plugin with no single label: dozens of 2,4-D amine registrations differ in strength and label wording, so the formulation code must come from the jug on hand rather than one chosen label.

No single Banvel product: the Banvel name is on three UPL registrations (70506-461 Banvel, 70506-505 Banvel 4 SL, 70506-503 Banvel 480) and the plugin names BASF, whose dicamba label never says Banvel. Pick the product first; formulation follows (label-research 2026-09-25).

Chaparral label (EPA 62719-597, 2024 and 2011 versions, plus Greenbook specimen) names no formulation type; only PPLS record says 'Water Dispersible Granule'. Product is dry, measured by volumetric cylinder or scale in ounces.

Generic 25(b) material with no single product label: corn gluten meal is sold as meal, powder, granules or pellets by many marketers (OMRI lists many). Plugin names no brand, so no label formulation to cite.

Crossbow label (62719-260, 2025-02-04) prints no formulation code or name (grep for emulsifiable/concentrate/formulation found none). PPLS lists 'Emulsifiable Concentrate', which counts only as corroboration.
E2E clickthrough test fixture, not a real product; no label, so no formulation code applies.

The DuraCor label (GF-3850, 62719-739, 2019-11-26) prints no formulation code or formulation name. PPLS lists 'Emulsifiable Concentrate', which counts only as corroboration. Needs a printed label or tech sheet.

The ET Herbicide/Defoliant label (71711-7, 2026-09-03, p3) prints no formulation code or name ('Contains 0.208 lb. pyraflufen ethyl per gallon'). PPLS lists 'Emulsifiable Concentrate'; its inactive brand name is 'ET-751 2.5% EC'. Corroboration only.
Generic 'Glyphosate 41%' names no single product; formulation must come from the specific jug's label (41% IPA-salt products are typically soluble liquids, but not verified per product).

GrazonNext HL master label (62719-628, 2017-03-13) prints no formulation code or wording; only the PPLS record says Emulsifiable Concentrate, which the brief allows as corroboration only. Newer PPLS files are supplemental labels.

Halex GT label (EPA 100-1282, 2025-01-15 and 2008-08-18 versions) prints no formulation type or code, only 'DoseLock Formulation Technology' and a.i. per gallon. PPLS record says 'Emulsifiable Concentrate' (corroboration only, not label).

Liberty ULTRA label (EPA 7969-500, 2025-10-30 and 2024-10-22) prints no formulation code or type; says only it 'is a water-soluble nonselective herbicide' and 'is formulated to mix readily in water'. PPLS formulations field is empty.

Me-Too-Lachlor II label (19713-549, 2023-01-04) prints no formulation code or wording ('7.8 pounds of active ingredient per gallon' only); PPLS record says Emulsifiable Concentrate, usable only as corroboration.

The manufacturer label (Soil Technologies Corp., OMRI 10/2022) calls it only a liquid 'herbicide CONCENTRATE' (clove oil 1.0%, 'SHAKE WELL'); it prints no formulation code or type that maps to the enum. The product is FIFRA 25(b) minimum-risk, so there is no EPA label.

Label (GF-4556, 62719-756, 2025-04-04, p3) calls it only 'An encapsulated herbicide'. It is a premix with encapsulated acetochlor, so CS vs ZC can't be settled, and it prints no code. PPLS formulation field is empty.

Stinger label (EPA 62719-73, 2019-03-11 and 2014-09-23 versions) prints no formulation code or type; states only clopyralid MEA salt 40.9% (3 lb ae/gal). PPLS record says 'Emulsifiable Concentrate' (not corroborated by label).

Weed Zap is a FIFRA 25(b) exempt product (no EPA label). JH Biotech label (2014) calls it only 'WEED ZAP concentrate' (45% clove oil, 45% cinnamon oil); no EC/SL/L code or formulation term. JH product profile says 'Form: Liquid' (not label).
Generic Btk entry with no label rate; the unit depends on which Bt product (dry DF/WG in lb vs liquid in fl oz) is purchased. Checked 2026-09-25, no single label applies.

Generic Btk entry: registered Btk products span DF, WG, WP, liquid and dust formulations (e.g. Javelin 6.4 WG, DiPel dust/DF), so no single label code applies. Use the brand plugins (dipel-df, javelin-wg).

Sources disagree: US label (62719-666, 2017 PPLS and 12-07-22 specimen) prints no code and only groups it with 'aqueous suspensions', separately from ECs; PPLS formulation field says Emulsifiable Concentrate. Likely SC; needs review.
Hand-applied pheromone dispenser (PPLS formulation 'Impregnated Materials', Isomate-C Plus EPA 53575-6); no spray formulation code applies.

Label (65564-1, PPLS 2011-07-19; Organic JMS Stylet-Oil specimen) prints no formulation code or type, only 'Mineral Oil 97.1%' diluted as a 'spray emulsion'. PPLS type 'Oils (no added pesticide)' maps to no code. Checked 2026-09-25.
Label 65564-1 (2011-07-19) prints no formulation code or name (only 'dilute spray emulsion'); PPLS type is 'Oils (no added pesticide)'. Undiluted 97.1% paraffinic oil, a liquid with no matching code.

M-Pede label (10163-324, accepted 2021-01-21) prints no formulation code or type; it only says 'The formulation is based on potassium salts of naturally derived fatty acids'. PPLS lists 'Soluble Concentrate' (SL) but that is an EPA-record field only.

Madex HP label (EPA 69553-1, 2026-09-22) prints no formulation code or name; it only says to mix with water, 0.5-3.0 fl oz/acre. PPLS type is 'Ready-to-Use Solution', which conflicts with dilution use. Liquid virus product, no confirmable code.

Master label for Majestene (base 'MBI-206 EP', EPA 84059-14, accepted 2026-02-02) prints no formulation code or type; it is a liquid of heat-killed Burkholderia cells. PPLS field says Emulsifiable Concentrate, not on the label. Checked 2026-09-25.
Mycotrol ESO is an alternate brand on the Mycotrol ES master label (EPA 82074-1), which sells the same formula as ES, OD, SC, SE and EW brands; PPLS says EC. No single code for 'Mycotrol ESO'.
Live beneficial nematodes are sold as infective juveniles in sachets/carrier (Koppert Entonem: sachets of 50 or 250 million). No spray formulation code applies.
Spear-Lep is an alternate brand of VST-006340 LC (now EPA 56336-97); siblings are 'Spear-T Liquid Concentrate' and 'VST-006340 SL', PPLS says Soluble Concentrate. Spear-Lep itself names no code.
Generic active-ingredient entry with no ratePerAcre. The unit (fl-oz for SC, oz for WP) depends on which spinosad product is bought, so none can be derived.
Generic active-ingredient entry. Spinosad is sold as SC (Entrust SC, Success), WP (Entrust 80W) and other formulations, so no single code applies without a specific product.
Live parasitoid release, sold as parasitized-egg cards or cups (Beneficial Insectary TRICHOforce B: 100,000 card or 8 oz cup). No spray formulation code applies.
Venerate XC is an alternate brand of MBI-206 EP (EPA 84059-14); the label names no standard formulation code or type ('EP' is not one). PPLS lists Emulsifiable Concentrate, unconfirmed on label.

Voliam Xpress label (100-1320, 2025-05-09) prints no code, only 'an aqueous based formulation'. PPLS says 'Emulsifiable Concentrate'. Sister Besiege calls it a Zeon Concentrate (CS + SC), which has no listed code. Liquid.

Cease label (264-1155-68539) calls it 'An Aqueous Suspension Biofungicide' with no code; PPLS lists base reg 264-1155 as Soluble Concentrate. Live-microbe suspension, no mapped code; SC is closest but unconfirmed.

Label (055146-00057-20220727) prints no formulation code or standard formulation words; Nufarm's product bulletin says 'FORMULATION dry prill' (not a mapped code). PPLS record says Water Dispersible Granule; dry product either way.

Mycoshield label 55146-97 (2019-11-07 master) prints no formulation code or formulation words (only 'Agricultural Antibiotic/Bactericide'). PPLS record says Wettable Powder (WP), corroboration only; needs label/tech sheet wording.

Phostrol label (055146-00083-20211208) prints no formulation code or formulation words (rates in pints product/A). PPLS record says Soluble Concentrate (SL) but label corroboration is missing; liquid either way.
Previcur Flex label (264-678, 2024-08-16) names no formulation code or type (only '6.0 lbs ... per gallon'); PPLS field says 'Flowable Concentrate'. Liquid, but no label formulation to cite.

ProPhyt master label 42519-22 (2025-10-24) prints no formulation code or formulation words (only 'systemic biofungicide containing potassium phosphite'); PPLS record says Soluble Concentrate (SL), corroboration only.

Serenade ASO label 264-1152 (2025-02-12) says 'AN AQUEOUS SUSPENSION BIOFUNGICIDE' with no code; PPLS lists Emulsifiable Concentrate, which conflicts. Live-microbe suspension; SC is closest but unconfirmed.
Generic plugin: '2,4-D Amine' names an active ingredient, not one registrant's product; dozens of EPA registrations exist and the number depends on the jug on hand (checked 2026-09-25).
Generic plugin: PPLS lists many active "2,4-D Amine" registrations (e.g. 87290-45, 33270-21, 93930-42, 1381-103, 62719-2), so the number depends on the jug on hand.
Generic plugin: PPLS lists many active "Atrazine 4L" registrations (e.g. 33270-10, 2749-657, 94730-23, 35915-4, 5905-470), so the number depends on the jug on hand.

Still ambiguous. BASF's DMA dicamba 7969-131 label names only 'BAS 183 06 H' (no Banvel). The Banvel name sits on UPL registrations (ex-BASF 51036-289): 70506-461 'Banvel Herbicide', 70506-505 'Banvel 4 SL', 70506-503 'Banvel 480'. None is BASF; pick by jug.
Generic plugin: PPLS lists many active clethodim 2EC registrations (e.g. 228-735, 38167-39, 87290-11, 92647-31, 34704-864), so the number depends on the jug on hand.

Generic: PPLS search 'Clethodim 2EC'/'Clethodim 2E' (2026-09-25) returns 12+ active registrations from different registrants (e.g. 38167-39, 87290-11, 93809-5, 34704-864, 70506-481, 228-735); number depends on the jug on hand.
Generic plugin: 'Clethodim 2EC' names an active ingredient and concentration sold by many registrants; the EPA number depends on the jug on hand (checked 2026-09-25).

Exempt/generic: corn gluten meal is a FIFRA 25(b) minimum-risk active; PPLS search 'Corn Gluten' (2026-09-25) returns no registrations. Plugin names no single marketed product, so there is no number to record.
E2E clickthrough test fixture, not a real product; no EPA registration exists or should be assigned.

Generic: PPLS search 'Glyphosate 41' (2026-09-25) returns many active registrations from different registrants (e.g. 5905-635, 87659-3, 84229-36, 85945-1, 88343-4, 71995-7, 103822-3); number depends on the jug on hand.

Generic: PPLS search 'Mesotrione 4SC' (2026-09-25) returns 10+ active registrations from different registrants (e.g. 89168-54, 93809-1, 84229-48, 42750-315, 93182-30, 87290-61, 60063-66); number depends on the jug on hand.

Plugin spans two brands: Treflan HFP is one registration (62719-250 transferred to Gowan as 10163-363 in 2016), but Trust is WinField 1381-146 or 1381-261 and no PPLS product is named Trust HFP. Use the number on the jug.

Generic active-ingredient entry, not one registrant's product: PPLS lists many active Btk registrations (e.g. 34 active DiPel records, Javelin 70051-60/70051-66), and DiPel DF and Javelin WG have their own plugins. Checked 2026-09-25.
Live entomopathogenic nematodes are macro-organisms, exempt from FIFRA registration under 40 CFR 152.20(a). No EPA number exists (producer page for Koppert Entonem shows no EPA reg. no.).

Generic entry: 'Spinosad' names an active ingredient, not one registrant's product. PPLS lists many spinosad products (Entrust, Success, Monterey etc.), each with its own number. The number depends on the product on hand.

Generic product: plugin names no registrant. PPLS lists many active wettable sulfurs (e.g. Drexel Sulfur 90W 19713-238, Yellow Jacket 6325-13, Clean Crop 6325-13-34704); the number depends on the bag on hand. Checked 2026-09-25.

Trichogramma egg parasitoids are macro-organisms (beneficial insects), exempt from FIFRA registration under 40 CFR 152.20(a). The producer page (Beneficial Insectary TRICHOforce B) shows no EPA number.
FIFRA 25(b) minimum-risk product (Soil Technologies Corp. label, OMRI 10/2022): 'This product has not been registered by the U.S. E.P.A.' No EPA Reg. No. exists; 82557-3 is Sinon Methomyl 90 WSP.
FIFRA 25(b) minimum-risk product (JH Biotech Weed Zap label: 'exempt from registration ... under section 25 (b) of FIFRA'). No EPA Reg. No.; 84718-1 does not exist in PPLS.

Generic plugin: several active dimethoate 4EC registrations (Loveland 34704-207, Drexel 19713-231, UPL 70506-453, FMC 279-3541); the number depends on the jug on hand. The previous 5905-368 was Omni Supreme Spray (a mineral oil).
